description: WAFLAby Scott Dilley CANBY, Ore. — Amanda Staehely worries about making Oregon’s new overtime law work at her nursery. She plans to hire more help, but also cut the hours of the nine workers she has now. “I hate doing that,” she said. “We have employees that have been here for a really long time […]
